branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar yolcu, yol, yürüyüş ve yolculuk alanındadır; yaya yolcu topluluğu yolun kendisinden ve genel yolculardan ayrılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yolculuk eden yaya topluluğa bağlıdır; komşu kol yaya olma durumunu daha genel işler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolculukta yaya giden kişilerin kalıplı topluluk adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaya olma, bineksiz kalma, yürüme gücü ve yürüyerek gitme daha geniş biçimde anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Binek kullanmadan ayakla gitme alanında örtüşürler.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yürüme şartını taşır; komşu kol yolcu veya yol ehli olmayı daha genel biçimde verir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaya olarak yürüyen yolcuları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol ehli, yolcular ve gelip gidenler daha geniştir; yaya olma şartı gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yolda bulunan veya yolculuk eden kişiler alanını paylaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol kişilere aittir; komşu kol yolun niteliğine aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolda yürüyen kişileri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üzerinden geçilen işlek yolu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yolculuk ve yürüyüş sahnesini paylaşırlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yolculuk sırasında yürüyerek giden kişiler için kalıplı bir adlandırma olarak sınırlar.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, bu topluluk adını binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcularla sınırlar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا

baseline.text: İnsanlardan hangisinin daha güzel iş yapacağını sınamak için yeryüzündekileri ona süs yaptık.

findings.text: Yeryüzünün çekiciliği değer kanıtı değil, kişinin bilinçli işini ortaya çıkaran ve sonucu tersine çevrilebilen sınama malzemesidir.
Süsün yeryüzünün üzerine konmuş ve kaldırılabilir bir görünüş katmanı olması, onun kalıcı değerden çok sınama aracı olduğunu belirginleştirir.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a condition supplies the deliberate staging of the earthly field.
External adornment supplies the attractive material through which choices are elicited.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure function of the display.
Good action and excellence make the comparison ethical and performative rather than aesthetic alone.
Intentional action identifies what human engagement with the display actually measures.

changed_reading.after: Earthly beauty is an intentionally configured decision field whose attractions make the comparative quality of purposeful action visible.
changed_reading.before: Earthly contents are beautiful, and people are tested in their presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate making turns the earth's contents into an attractive external field that elicits purposeful responses; the comparative object of disclosure is the quality of action, not the beauty of the display.

activation_trace.role: An external adornment supplies a surface capable of being handled and depleted.
Testing and appearance of condition retain the lexical center of the focus verb.
Wear through use supplies the exploratory material process by which conduct leaves evidence.
Purposeful action is the use that marks the finite surface.

changed_reading.after: The test may also be pictured as use wearing through a finite decorative layer, exposing the quality of the user's action in the traces left behind.
changed_reading.before: The test occurs while an attractive world remains available.

baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory for ب ل و keeps testing beside the branch image of material wear: engagement consumes or abrades the adornment, so the manner of use becomes legible as the attractive layer ages.

activation_trace.role: Good action anchors excellence in what is done rather than in how the earthly surface looks.
Purposeful work is the focus element whose criterion is revised.
Deviation from straightness supplies the defect explicitly negated before the focus.
Uprightness and balance supply a positive calibration for qualitative superiority.
Fitness for a thing makes good work responsive to what its situation requires.
Repairing a break on a bend turns recompense into a branch image of corrective work.

changed_reading.after: Best work is especially the action that keeps or restores things in right alignment and fit, even when that action is less visually impressive than the adornment around it.
changed_reading.before: Best work is the superior intentional response elicited by an attractive world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence opposes crookedness with uprightness, then joins صالح action to a حسن recompense whose branch inventory also images repairing a break on a bend. This revises 'best work' from impressive performance toward work that restores alignment and fitness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deviation, uprightness, fitness, and a repair image; I infer an evaluative arrow from those cues to restorative action in 18:7. A live alternative is that the sequence only contrasts truth with error and promises reward, without making repair the criterion.
structural_cues: 18:1-2 moves from negated crookedness to an upright text, صالح deeds, and a حسن recompense immediately before 18:7.

activation_trace.role: The removable external adornment supplies the variable that the following state subtracts.
Wear and loss through use supply a focus-side image for the transition from display to exposed residue.
The face of the earth supplies the bare support that remains when surface contents are removed.
Ground cut off from vegetation supplies the concrete subtraction of the adorned layer.

changed_reading.after: Adornment is a deliberately temporary test variable whose removal separates transient surface value from the durable quality of action.
changed_reading.before: Adorned earthly contents are the stable setting in which conduct is compared.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the earth-surface frame but replaces adornment with exposed ground cut free of vegetation. The reversal functions as an ablation of the attractive variable: decoration is temporary, while the action disclosed through it is the candidate durable signal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and its material reversal; I infer that removal reveals what the display elicited. The live alternative is simple destruction after the test, with no claim that stripping itself has a disclosure function.
structural_cues: 18:8 repeats first-person making and 'what is upon it' from 18:7, but reverses the predicate from adornment to bare, vegetationless ground.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes the true condition appear supplies the focus-side disclosure process.
The branch image of utmost effort gives the comparative a dimension that can unfold over time.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit result parallel to the focus test.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies a measurable record rather than a momentary impression.
Remaining in a place supplies duration across which a condition can become manifest.

changed_reading.after: The test lets the quality and extent of action become externally manifest across time, so comparison rests on an enacted record rather than appearance.
changed_reading.before: The test selects which people perform better acts amid earthly beauty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close syntactic echo 'so that We know which of the two groups' pairs disclosure with exhaustive counting of a period of remaining. It sharpens testing as temporal externalization: differences become manifest and comparable in an enacted record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic parallel, disclosure, exhaustive counting, and duration; I infer that the test produces a temporally inspectable record rather than new divine information. The alternative is narrower: 18:12 may concern only which group calculated the stay correctly.
structural_cues: 18:7 'لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ' and 18:12 'لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ' are parallel first-person purpose clauses followed by a comparative interrogative.

activation_trace.role: Fertile, enabling ground supplies the material field as usable provision rather than inert scenery.
Beautification of earth by growth supplies an attractive affordance that can be used well or poorly.
Purposeful action anchors the model in human use of the prepared setting.
Preparation and readiness supply the configured character of the protective environment.
Utility and benefit supply the practical yield expected from the setting.
Passing a place to one side supplies calibrated rather than total solar exposure.
Directed sight and insight supply active discernment within an ordinary market choice.
Fitness and suitability refine 'best' into the option most apt for the need.
Livelihood and good condition supply the modest material provision being evaluated.
Fineness and hiddenness supply discreet execution as part of good action.

changed_reading.after: The earthly field is also a calibrated set of affordances, and the best action is discerning, fitted, restrained use of provision with attention to consequences and visibility.
changed_reading.before: Earthly attractiveness provokes choices that reveal moral quality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cave sequence presents material surroundings as prepared utility, calibrated exposure, livelihood, and a demand for discerning, fitting, discreet action. Earthly adornment therefore becomes an affordance field: goodness lies in how precisely one uses provision, not in maximizing possession or visibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, benefit, lateral exposure, comparative selection, livelihood, and discretion; I infer an ecology of fitted use and carry it back to the earth's adornment. The alternative confines these details to protection of the cave companions rather than a general model of the focus test.
structural_cues: 18:16 asks for a prepared utility, 18:17 describes a physically modulated habitat, and 18:19 echoes 18:7's comparative frame with 'which food is most fitting/pure.'

activation_trace.role: Excellence in doing anchors the proposed criterion of responsible, revisable agency.
Purposeful action is the focus object qualified by the later speech about future doing.
Producing an act supplies the explicit future-action claim whose certainty is checked.
Recovering what was absent from mind supplies an internal correction mechanism.
Loss of remembrance supplies the fallible condition from which action must recover.
Gentle direction to the right path supplies the corrective trajectory.
Nearness supplies comparative improvement as movement toward, not possession of, right direction.

changed_reading.after: Best work also includes honest limits on one's claimed agency, remembrance after lapse, and willingness to revise toward a nearer right course.
changed_reading.before: Best work is primarily the best completed response to the world's attractions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition on self-certifying tomorrow's deed, followed by remembrance after forgetting and movement toward nearer guidance, makes corrigibility part of action's quality. 'Best work' includes truthful calibration of agency and the capacity to revise direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a future deed claim, fallible memory, correction, and comparative nearness to guidance; I infer that action is judged partly by humility and corrigibility. The alternative is a rule for speech about the future that does not redefine 'best work.'
structural_cues: 18:23-24 interrupts an absolute claim to act tomorrow with dependence on divine will, then pairs forgetting with remembrance and a request for closer guidance.

remaining_uncertainties: The wear and commission branches are productive analogies but remain form-distant from the ordinary focus senses.
The calibrated-affordance model may describe the cave episode specifically rather than the whole category of earthly adornment.
The 18:12 parallel strongly supports manifestation, but it does not by itself settle every theological implication of 'so that We know/test.'
The memorial-layer reading depends on carrying a later communal construction back to the focus and should remain exploratory.
strongest_changes: The opening's crooked/upright/repair sequence recalibrates 'best work' toward restorative fitness rather than display.
18:8 turns the adorned surface into an ablatable layer, distinguishing transient beauty from the action it exposes.
The cave sequence makes the earthly field a calibrated set of affordances, while the echoed comparative in 18:19 locates excellence in fitting, discreet material choice.
The purpose-clause echo in 18:12 casts testing as manifestation through duration and an inspectable record.
18:23-24 adds humility and corrigibility to the quality of action.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly replays the focus grammar of making, comparative selection, and disclosure, but at different scales: textual straightness, stripped terrain, measured duration, a tuned habitat, an ordinary food choice, and revised future agency.

activation_trace.role: A reward appointed for work supplies the analogy of the earthly field as a commission that solicits performance.
A worker's wage supplies the reciprocal economic image attached to judged work.
Recompense for work reinforces the commission analogy immediately before the focus.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, adornment can function like a posted commission or advance that calls forth work and exposes whether the worker's performance merits its value.
changed_reading.before: Adornment is an object of attraction that tests the people who encounter it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant compensation branches of جعل and عمل rather than the ordinary finite verb and action noun. It remains anchored in the focus pair 'We made'/'work' and is reinforced by the nearby reward for deeds; downstream prose should present it only as an economic analogy, never as a lexical replacement or translation.

activation_trace.role: Making something into a condition anchors the later community's transformation of a discovered site.
External adornment supplies the image of a human-made layer placed over an underlying sign.
Purposeful work anchors communal construction as conduct open to evaluation.
Disclosure of what was hidden supplies the trace that becomes available for public framing.
Joining parts into a structure supplies the new visible layer proposed over the discovered people.
Prevailing power supplies the social mechanism that selects which memorial framing is built.
A designated place of prostration supplies the institutional form imposed on the site.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the test continues when communities add visible memorial layers over disclosed traces, revealing how power converts signs into institutions and adornment.
changed_reading.before: What lies on earth is already an adornment through which individual conduct is tested.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later community's construction over the discovered companions is projected back onto 'what is upon the earth.' It remains anchored in making, surface adornment, and purposeful work, while 18:21 visibly supplies discovery, construction, dominance, and a worship-place; downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary communal test of framing traces, not the primary sense of 18:7.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا ... عَمَلًا

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Beauty is manufactured test material.** `ج ع ل` B002 (“turning something into a state”) assigns the earth’s contents the state of adornment; `ع م ل` B001 makes the response intentional. The two gardens (18:32–42) and worldly adornment (18:28, 46) later show beauty prompting false permanence. I infer that adornment does not reveal worth but elicits action. The ayah reverses the normal evidentiary direction from attractive object to good judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The garden’s collapse at 18:32–42 made adornment’s role as test material concrete rather than abstract.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Adornment as a test overlay.** `ز ي ن/B003` identifies adornment as that by which something is beautified, while `ز ي ن/B002` stresses making beauty show. The phrase `مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ` locates it on a surface, and 18:8 removes that layer by making the same surface barren; 18:6–7 also reverses grief into evaluated action. I infer that removability is what makes the beauty a test instrument. The earth’s attractiveness reads as a displayed overlay that reveals agents’ work, not as evidence of lasting worth.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:8 revealed that the beautifying layer can be deliberately stripped, confirming adornment as test apparatus rather than stable value.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person plural assertion opening the design statement
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) opens the ayah as certified divine disclosure. The particle and attached speaker pronoun make authority and verification arrive before the making verb, so the coming claim about earthly adornment and testing is not a neutral observation but a declared design principle. The boundary from 18:6 also matters: personal grief is answered by a majestic cosmological assertion.

topics.headline: certified divine disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins from disclosed divine authority before it describes the world as an adorned testing field.
topics.reason: The particle analysis, fused speaker form, opening position, recitational pressure, and 18:6 boundary rows all support emphatic certified disclosure as the local effect.

words.gloss_range: perfect first-person plural making/rendering in a double-object assignment frame
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) carries the certified speaker into completed action. Its double-object frame renders {{ar:مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:mā ʿalā al-arḍi}}) as {{ar:زِينَةًۭ}} ({{tr:zīnatan}}), so beauty is an assigned function of the terrestrial field rather than a separate object. The verb also becomes the pivot for {{ar:لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ}} ({{tr:li-nabluwahum}}): completed arrangement is disclosed as the setup for evaluation, with Surah 18 later echoing the root in reversal and judgment settings (18:1, 18:8, 18:57).
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, rendering, assigning, and configuring; locally the double-object frame selects assigned status rather than bare creation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the full relative earth-surface object rendered as adornment
the assigned adornment complement in the double-object frame
the purpose clause governed by the purpose lām, stating the testing function of the making

topics.headline: assigned adornment frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb assigns an adornment-status to the whole earth-surface object rather than merely reporting that attractive things exist.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence force a transitive double-object frame, so broad root senses are narrowed to rendering and assigning in this local construction.

topics.headline: divine agency and design chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a continuous divine agency chain from assertion to making to testing, with the making verb serving as the structural pivot.
topics.reason: The first-person plural morphology, perfect aspect, purpose attachment, and sequence rows converge on completed divine arrangement that leads into the test clause.

topics.headline: surah root echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same making root links this ayah to the surah opening and to the next ayah where adornment is removed.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows supply concrete Surah 18 references, so the root echo survives as a local commentary candidate without controlling the parse.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun gathering the whole earth-surface object
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is relative, not interrogative or negative. It waits for {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-arḍi}}) to complete the object, so the phrase gathers whatever lies on the earth before that whole set is assigned adornment.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the surface phrase that completes the relative pronoun and fixes its scope

topics.headline: unrestricted relative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is an open earth-surface set, not a single named class of beautiful things.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a relative pronoun serving as object, and the CRITICAL rows coherently preserve the delayed, unrestricted object scope.

words.gloss_range: surface-relation preposition defining the terrestrial scope of the relative object
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns the broad relative pronoun into a surface-domain expression. The preposition governs {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}), foregrounding what is visible upon the earth rather than what is hidden within it, and it widens the prior grief-scene into the arena of the test.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed noun completing the surface-domain prepositional phrase

topics.headline: surface-domain scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adornment claim concerns the manifest earth-surface field, not an undefined location or interior containment.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically attached to the relative object and semantically supplies superposition, so the surface-domain payoff is locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: definite concrete earth as the governed, unified testing surface and pronoun antecedent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the known earth as one governed surface-domain. Its definiteness and singular collective force make the arena cosmological, while the feminine noun anchors {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}) and keeps the adornment assigned to earth rather than to the tested humans. Its low-ground concreteness makes the test materially staged, and 18:8 immediately answers the adorned surface with barren ground.
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, earth, and the low material domain; locally definite concrete earth under a surface preposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following attribution phrase whose suffix resumes the feminine earth-side referent

topics.headline: known earth domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth as the single shared arena on which the adornment-and-test apparatus is staged.
topics.reason: Definiteness, singular domain force, governed case, and scene-order rows all support the earth as the ayah's known surface field.

topics.headline: earth attribution anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth remains grammatically active as the antecedent and governed domain, not as a human possession or direct object.
topics.reason: Attachment and cross-reference evidence strongly license the feminine earth noun as the antecedent for the following suffix and as governed by the surface preposition.

topics.headline: material ground and reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the adorned surface as low material ground that can be stripped into barrenness in 18:8.
topics.reason: The lexical ground image and immediate next-ayah contrast preserve a concrete payoff while remaining secondary to the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adornment as assigned display-quality and test interface
words.prose: {{ar:زِينَةًۭ}} ({{tr:zīnatan}}) lands as the assigned adornment-quality of the earth-surface object. The main grammar favors a second-object complement, while a circumstantial reading remains a licensed variant of the same accusative surface. Its indefiniteness keeps the adornment qualitatively open, and the root field lets real beauty and lure-pressure coexist: what is made attractive becomes the interface through which action is tested. Surah 18 later narrows this worldly adornment thread at 18:46, while 18:8 shows its removability.
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, adornment, display, and making attractive; locally the noun names a divinely assigned attractive state with test pressure

topics.headline: assigned adornment complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices adornment as the assigned quality of the whole earth-surface object, while the accusative also allows a circumstantial nuance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the second object of the making verb; the CRITICAL rows preserve the alternate circumstantial parse as a narrowed grammatical option.

topics.headline: beauty as test interface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beauty is real enough to adorn and attractive enough to test, so the world's appeal becomes evaluative rather than merely decorative.
topics.reason: The root-semantics, co-occurrence, and synthesis rows converge on adornment as an attractive display through which action is evaluated.

topics.headline: open quality and surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an open adornment category that later becomes concrete in 18:46 and is immediately fragile in 18:8.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness, cadence, and inter-ayah rows add a valid thread without changing the local second-object grammar.

words.gloss_range: attribution lām binding adornment to the earth before the purpose lām appears
words.prose: The first lām, {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}), belongs to {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}), not to the later purpose clause. It attaches the adornment back to the feminine earth-side referent before testing is introduced. The attachment may be described through the adornment noun or through the making verb, but the payoff is stable: beauty is assigned to the earth, not possessed by the human group.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the full attribution phrase formed by the lām and feminine suffix

topics.headline: earth attribution lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first lām as earth-attribution, distinct from the following purpose lām and from human possession.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence allows more than one head for the phrase, so the topic is narrowed to the stable local function of attribution to the earth-side referent.

words.gloss_range: feminine suffix pronoun returning the adornment phrase to the earth
words.prose: {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) keeps the earth grammatically present after the noun has passed. The strongest local routing points back to {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}); possible routing through the whole earth-surface phrase is a narrower alternative, but the suffix still separates the earth that bears adornment from the masculine plural group tested next.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the nearby feminine antecedent most strongly resumed by the suffix

topics.headline: feminine earth pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun routes adornment back to the earth-side referent before the tested humans enter the grammar.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence strongly licenses the earth as antecedent, while CRITICAL alternate-routing rows survive as a narrowed possibility that does not overturn the earth-attribution payoff.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām subordinating the testing verb to the making of adornment
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the hinge from design statement to purpose clause. Unlike the previous attribution lām, this particle governs the following verb and makes {{ar:نَبْلُوَهُمْ}} ({{tr:nabluwahum}}) dependent on the making-act, so the beauty clause is disclosed as functional rather than self-contained.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following testing verb governed by the purpose lām

topics.headline: purpose hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely add a test after beauty; it subordinates beauty to the stated purpose of testing.
topics.reason: The local syntax forces this particle as purpose lām governing the following verb, and the CRITICAL rows consistently mark it as the structural pivot.

words.gloss_range: direct Form I testing verb under purpose lām with bound human object
words.prose: {{ar:نَبْلُوَهُمْ}} ({{tr:nabluwahum}}) names the purpose as direct testing of the bound human object. The subjunctive imperfect keeps the test dependent on the purpose particle and projected from the completed arrangement. Its root field adds exposure under pressure, with good-trial, wearing, and renewal images coloring the test without replacing the local sense. The verb also mediates the ayah: adorned design leads to a criterion question, and that criterion is deed-quality, with related creation-test formulas appearing at 11:7 and 67:2.
words.root_gloss_range: testing, proving, exposing under pressure, affliction, wearing, and renewal; locally direct testing that reveals action-quality

topics.headline: purpose-governed test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices testing as the stated purpose of the completed arrangement, not as an independent afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support an imperfect verb governed by purpose lām, matching the aspect and subordination rows.

topics.headline: direct tested object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human group is fused into the test verb as its object while the earth remains the bearer of adornment.
topics.reason: The object suffix is syntactically forced and discourse-inferred, so the directness of the tested object is locally anchored.

topics.headline: pressure and evaluation axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices trial as an exposing pressure that leads toward comparative deed-quality, while nonlocal renewal and wearing images remain supporting color.
topics.reason: V4/root evidence supports trial, exposure, wearing, and renewal branches, but the local verb under the purpose clause selects testing as the governing sense.

words.gloss_range: elative comparative excellence as the value predicate of the embedded criterion
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْسَنُ}} ({{tr:aḥsanu}}) supplies the value sought by the embedded selector. As an elative, it asks for the best or most beautifully good response, not mere adequacy; the following {{ar:عَمَلًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) locks that excellence to deeds. The beauty-goodness root also answers the earlier adornment term: the response to beauty is measured as beautiful-good action, and the phrase recurs as a creation-test formula (11:7; 67:2) while Surah 18 later returns to action and reward language (18:30; 18:88).
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and doing beautifully; locally an elative measuring deed-quality

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative gerund specifying the domain of excellence as deed-quality
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَلًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) resolves the criterion at the ayah's close. As an indefinite accusative specification after {{ar:أَحْسَنُ}} ({{tr:aḥsanu}}), it makes action the field of excellence, not appearance, possession, or status. Its gerund and singular form keep the measure broad and qualitative, pointing to deliberate conduct or produced practice rather than a tally of deed-items. The final position makes action the audible endpoint of the adorned-world test, while the same formula and root-pair return in 11:7, 67:2, and Surah 18's later promise language (18:30; 18:88).
